evidence.finding: Current FR*EVZ stations are labelled across EVzen, CARF, Norauto and other networks/sites; SMEG Développement commonly appears as aménageur while GreenFlux Assets is operator/platform.
GreenFlux positions itself as an eMobility/CPO platform provider for CPO customers rather than a single retail tariff authority.
EVzen first-party distinguishes its own network from networks operated by EVzen and states EVzen charging prices vary; exact price is shown in app/screen/QR.
CARF has a distinct first-party time-based tariff.
Simone has a distinct first-party day/night kWh and post-charge tariff.

conclusion: FR*EVZ cannot be assigned one direct tariff. Exact EVSE -> underlying network/site tariff authority is required; current public evidence does not deterministically cover the historical 45 stations/110 PDC.
reopenCondition: Deterministic FR*EVZ EVSE -> underlying first-party network/site mapping plus current tariff grid, or a GreenFlux/EVzen guest endpoint exposing exact direct tariff per EVSE.
